CustomField.description: Where the payment came from in Zeffy (data.type): Online (donation form), Manual (entered by hand by staff in Zeffy) or Imported. A deleted Manual payment is removed from Salesforce; Online/Imported ones are kept as Canceled.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Online = donor paid through the Zeffy form. Manual = entered by hand by staff in Zeffy. Imported = imported into Zeffy.
